title: American Delicate Chocolate Pancake
description: A classic American pancake recipe elevated by the delicate flavor of chocolate.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Fold in the delicate chocolate chips.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve with pancake syrup and powdered sugar.
